chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji'abi reported to me from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, who reported from Ghandar Muhammad, who reported from Shu'bah, from Salamah ibn Kuhayl, from Abu al-Tufayl Amir ibn Wathilah al-Kinani, may Allah bless him with mercy, who said: I heard the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) say:
"The things I fear most for you are two: prolonged hope and following desires. As for prolonged hope, it makes one forget the Hereafter; and as for following desires, it diverts one from the truth.

Behold! The world has indeed turned its back departing, and the Hereafter has arrived approaching. Each of them has children, so be among the children of the Hereafter and do not be among the children of this world. For today is the day of action and no accounting, and the Hereafter is for accounting and no action."

key_terms.أبناء الآخرة: Children of the Hereafter — those who prioritize the next life through righteous deeds
key_terms.اتباع الهوى: Following desires — submitting to base passions and temptations
key_terms.طول الأمل: Prolonged hope — excessive attachment to worldly expectations that distracts from spiritual preparation

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the dangers of long hope and following desires?
ai.summary: In this sermon delivered to his followers in Kufa, Imam Ali (AS) warned against two spiritual dangers: prolonged worldly hopes that cause forgetfulness of the Hereafter, and following base desires that obstruct the path of truth. He used the vivid metaphor of the world and the Hereafter each having "children" — urging his audience to align themselves with the Hereafter by acting now, since this life is the arena of deeds while the next life is only for reckoning.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
